# Action Global News

> Independent news for operators on AI and AI search, business, markets, small business, global ecommerce, health and Colorado. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Original reporting with cited sources; every story lists its sources.

Publisher: Action Global News, 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204. Phone 1-800-481-8638.
Disclosure: articles about companies that share ownership with the publisher are labeled "From our network"; articles about clients of the publisher's agency are labeled "Sponsored". Full list of affiliated businesses: https://actionglobalnews.com/disclosure/

- [Two critical PHP flaws sent governments scrambling to take websites offline. Within hours, attack attempts were counted in the millions, government sites in Europe went dark as a precaution, and security agencies told anyone who could not patch to unplug. Here is what happened, in plain terms, and the checklist a small business with a WordPress or other PHP site should work through this week.

Officials announced both detections on October 21 and are widening surveillance and fly trapping.

The outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May has now produced more than 9,600 confirmed cases.

Here is how both can be true](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/antarctic-ozone-hole-2026-second-largest-recovery/): Satellite data from Europe's Copernicus service show the hole opened early and grew to roughly 27.4 million square kilometers by September 20, close to the 2015 record for that time of year. Atmospheric scientists attribute the size mostly to an unusually strong, cold polar vortex rather than more ozone-destroying chemicals.

- [AI search optimization: how a small business gets named inside the answer](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/ai-search-optimization-small-business/): Search used to send people to a list of links. Increasingly it hands them a finished answer. For local and small businesses, the job has shifted from ranking on a page to being one of the few names an AI system is willing to cite.
- [Bathroom remodeling for elderly parents: the aging-in-place decisions that matter most](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/bathroom-remodel-for-elderly-parents/): Searches for senior bathroom remodels have jumped this year, and for good reason. The bathroom is where small design decisions have the largest effect on whether someone can keep living at home.
- [The data center backlash has found its issue: the electricity bill](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/data-center-backlash-electricity-bills/): Local fights over hyperscale facilities used to be about noise and land. Now they are about household power costs, and the opposition no longer sorts neatly by party.
- [More than one in four U.S. workers now fear technology will make their job obsolete](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/gallup-tech-job-fears-2026/): Gallup’s latest reading is a record, and the worry has moved into groups that used to feel insulated. For employers, the anxiety is now a management problem whether or not the layoffs ever arrive.
- [Losing weight on a GLP-1? The muscle you keep matters as much as the pounds you lose](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/glp1-muscle-loss-protein-strength/): The newest weight-loss medications work. The body-composition data from their trials also shows a cost that is easy to miss on a bathroom scale, and the research on how to limit it is getting clearer.
- [A press release written for the machines that now decide who gets quoted](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/machine-readable-press-releases/): Traditional wires sell reach to newsrooms. A newer kind of wire sells something narrower and, for small companies, often more useful: a permanent, dated, attributed record that search engines and AI systems can read without guessing.
- [SBA disaster loans, explained for small business owners who have never needed one](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/sba-disaster-loans-small-business-guide/): After a declared disaster, the federal government’s largest source of recovery money for businesses is a loan, not a grant. Here is how it works, what it covers and why waiting for the insurance check is the most common mistake.
- [Rent, buy or subscribe to own: the real cost of a small business website](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/subscribe-to-own-website-model/): The sticker price of a website tells you very little. What matters is what you pay over the life of the site, what you own at the end of it, and who is accountable when it does not perform.
- [The White House renamed AI “Super Intelligence.” Here is what actually changes for business](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/super-intelligence-executive-order-business/): A terminology order, a federal definition still to come, and a voluntary accord signed by the biggest model builders. The practical footprint is narrower than the headlines, but it is not zero.
- [A free national business directory built on open map data, not scraped listings](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/usabusinesssearch-free-business-directory/): Most directories either scrape other directories or charge businesses to exist. USABusinessSearch.com starts from open map data, lists businesses free, and lets owners claim and correct their own records.
- [Conversational AI has quietly become table stakes for small business websites](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/conversational-ai-small-business/): The demos are easy and the deployments are not. What separates an assistant that earns its place from one that gets switched off in week three.
- [Marketing inside the most scrutinized category in medicine](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/glp1-telehealth-marketing/): Weight-management telehealth operates under advertising restrictions most businesses never encounter. What a compliant acquisition strategy looks like when most of the usual channels say no by default.
- [The quiet distribution channel: what happens inside local buy-sell groups](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/local-groups-distribution/): Community commerce networks move real volume and almost nobody measures them properly. A look at how they work, why they are fragile, and what businesses get wrong about them.
- [The press release didn’t die. It got rebuilt for machines that read](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/press-release-ai-search/): Wire distribution collapsed as an SEO tactic more than a decade ago. The format underneath turns out to suit machine retrieval almost perfectly — and almost nobody is writing for it.
- [A browser-based flight simulator aimed at student pilots launches without a download](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/vr-flight-simulator-launch/): No install, no headset, no client. The pitch is procedural familiarity before you start paying for airtime — and it says something about how far browser 3D has come.
- [The world’s first walk-in VR shopping mall opens its doors — and every storefront is a real business](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/world-vr-mall-launch/): World VR Mall lets shoppers walk a three-dimensional concourse and step into storefronts that route through to live ecommerce sites. It is a bet that browsing, not searching, is what online retail has been missing.
